premise: Tree is ticklish; Squirrel and Raccoon try to climb him without tickling, but every step sets him giggling, until he laughs so hard his leaves come down in a golden shower.
inspiration: Folk laughing-tree and giant-with-a-secret motifs, turned: the giant's weakness is a giggle, and the leaf shower is a treat for everyone.
lesson: Laughing together is worth a few fallen leaves.

en-US.title: The Ticklish Tree
en-US.text: Here is a secret about Tree. He is ticklish. Squirrel found out first. She {squirrel:hop x2} scampered up his trunk and Tree went {tree:wobble} hee. Squirrel stopped. Tree? Nothing, said Tree. Go on. She scampered a bit higher. {tree:wobble x2} Hee hee! Raccoon heard and came to see. {raccoon:pulse} Let me try, said Raccoon, and climbed very, very slowly, with their soft careful paws. Hee. Hee hee. HEE HEE HEE! Tree {tree:shake 0.6} shook all over. Stop, stop! laughed Tree. Squirrel and Raccoon held on tight. Mouse peeped out from the roots. What's so funny? Everything! gasped Tree, and he laughed so hard that his leaves, red and gold and brown, came showering down. Whee! They landed in piles. Squirrel jumped in one. Raccoon jumped in another. Tree took a deep, wobbly breath. Phew, he said. Same time tomorrow? Squirrel {squirrel:hop} was already climbing. {tree:wobble} Hee.

es-ES.title: El árbol con cosquillas
es-ES.text: Aquí va un secreto sobre Árbol. Tiene cosquillas. Ardilla lo descubrió primero. {squirrel:hop x2} Trepó por su tronco y Árbol hizo {tree:wobble} ji. Ardilla se paró. ¿Árbol? Nada, dijo Árbol. Sigue. Trepó un poco más. {tree:wobble x2} ¡Ji, ji! Mapache lo oyó y vino a ver. {raccoon:pulse} Déjame a mí, dijo Mapache, y trepó muy, muy despacio, con sus manos suaves y cuidadosas. Ji. Ji, ji. ¡JI, JI, JI! Árbol {tree:shake 0.6} temblaba entero. ¡Parad, parad!, se reía Árbol. Ardilla y Mapache se agarraron fuerte. Ratón asomó entre las raíces. ¿De qué os reís? ¡De todo!, jadeó Árbol, y se rio tanto que sus hojas, rojas, doradas y marrones, cayeron como una lluvia. ¡Yupi! Se juntaron en montones. Ardilla saltó a uno. Mapache saltó a otro. Árbol respiró hondo, todavía temblando. Uf, dijo. ¿Mañana otra vez? Ardilla {squirrel:hop} ya estaba trepando. {tree:wobble} Ji.
